name: Cinematic
thesis: The app is a stage: image, atmosphere, and timing do the work; the interface stays out of the frame.
bestFor: Film, music, events, nightlife, streaming, photography, and culture.

variants.name: Film Festival
variants.summary: A poster wall: full-bleed key art, oversized titles, and minimal chrome.
variants.signature: A title that bleeds into the image.
variants.treatment: Full-bleed imagery, oversized display type, dark chrome, and a horizontal line-up.

variants.name: Gallery
variants.summary: A white cube: large images, quiet labels, and a lot of air.
variants.signature: A caption set in the margin, not under the image.
variants.treatment: Light surfaces, a serif display face, measured captions, and very little chrome.

variants.name: Nightclub
variants.summary: A dark stage: one neon accent, a stacked line-up, and high contrast.
variants.treatment: Near-black background, a single electric accent, condensed type, and a tight vertical line-up.

signatureMoves: A title that bleeds into the image.
A caption set in the margin, not under the image.
A full-bleed image that changes with the scroll.

platform.ios: Use a full-bleed hero under the status bar with a scrim only where text sits. Keep the system back button. Use a transparent navigation bar that becomes opaque on scroll. Sheets for details. Tab bar for peers.
platform.android: Edge-to-edge with a transparent top app bar and a scrim. Predictive back. Use a bottom sheet for details. No FAB. Keep the system bars legible over imagery.

principles: One image, one title, one time.
Text over media needs a measured scrim.
Motion is a cut or a fade, not a bounce.
avoid: A grid of equal cards over a hero image.
Neon gradients with no content reason.
A play button on media that does not play.

content.title: Aftersun
content.subtitle: A film by Charlotte Wells · 102 min

screens.home: A full-bleed hero for the featured event, a time-and-venue line, then a horizontal line-up of alternatives. The hero is the only image at full width.
screens.detail: An image-led detail: title, time, venue, a short description, and one reserve action. Keep the back gesture.
screens.compose: A short booking flow: date, time, quantity, seat or tier, payment. Show the real price and fees before confirmation.
screens.profile: A ticket wallet: upcoming and past, with clear dates and venues. No fake loyalty points.

components.button: Solid accent with high contrast; a text-only secondary. Avoid pills unless the whole shape language is soft.
components.list: Horizontal poster cards with 3:4 or 2:3 imagery, title and time below. Do not wrap each card in another card.
components.input: Minimal underline or filled field, large touch targets, clear error text.
components.navigation: Transparent top bar over imagery, tab bar for peers, sheets for detail.
